facts: Parties: Hartwell Software Ltd (Buyer), Galloway Logistics plc (Seller); the Company is Delamere Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 10 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 12 July 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $325,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $1,200,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $3,150,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $64,300,000.
